svg.title: What to back up and where it goes
svg.desc: Pi Zero: export the Pi-hole settings with Settings > Teleporter after any change. Pi 5: create a System and Kodi backup in /storage/backup/ (settings, add-ons, library, controller maps, game saves) and copy it off through the Backup Samba share monthly and before major updates; stop the containers and copy /storage/docker/ off monthly. Keep at least one copy off both Pis, on the NAS or a laptop. Optionally image each SD card before risky changes.

g.text: on the NAS or a laptop
keep at least one copy here
